prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 1425px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照SaaS服务合同各条款的原文、修订后文本和修订说明，帮助读者理解变更。","reading":"读者先按条款号定位，再横向比较原文与修订后文本，最后查看修订说明；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。手机宽度下，长条款会形成高行，较短单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["原文与修订后是直接对照的一组，宽度应支持逐行比较；修订后内容更长，可按策略给予更多空间。","修订说明与两版条款同属一行，解释该条变更；条款号则承担定位作用。"],"keep_intact":["条款号，如第3.1条、第12.4条","数字、编号及合同中的专有名称应尽可能保持完整"],"may_wrap":["原文和修订后文本可按中文语义自然换行","修订说明可自然换行","表头可在必要时换行，但应保持易辨认"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [83, 73, 122, 81] · table 360×3962px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 804, 850, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [83, 79, 116, 81] · table 360×3962px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 804, 850, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [83, 81, 124, 71] · table 360×3962px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 804, 850, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"条款号保持完整，修订后获得最多宽度，三类内容仍能在同一行内对应。","problems":"原文和修订说明都被压成很窄的文字列，频繁换行；修订说明表头也分成两行。长行中的空白使横向比对需要反复沿行寻找对应内容。","cause":"原文宽73px、修订说明宽81px，扣除21px后分别只有52px和60px可容纳文字；修订后虽有122px，面对远长于其他列的内容仍然很窄。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"原文比r2A多6px，名义上更有利于阅读；条款号完整，行内对应关系清楚。","problems":"渲染结果与r2A几乎一样：原文和说明仍显拥挤，说明表头换行，修订后形成很高的文字块。","cause":"原文79px扣除内边距和边框后仍只有58px；修订后减至116px。现有数据中三稿的行高完全相同，这几像素的调整没有带来可见的整体改善。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"修订后名义上获得124px，原文81px也比r2A宽；条款号仍完整。","problems":"修订说明尤其狭窄，说明文字和表头的断行削弱了作为解释列的可读性；整体高度与其他两稿相同。","cause":"修订说明只有71px，扣除内边距和边框后仅50px；增加给原文和修订后的宽度不足以明显改变当前渲染的行高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"revision-priority","widths":[83,65,130,81],"change":"保留完整条款号和说明列，将原文缩至65px，把空间集中给最长的修订后文本；检验能否改善主要对照文本的连续性。"},{"name":"balanced-comparison","widths":[83,76,134,66],"change":"给原文保留比第一方案更多的空间，同时扩大修订后；说明列缩窄，测试以牺牲说明列换取两版合同文本可读性的取舍。"},{"name":"explanation-priority","widths":[83,65,116,95],"change":"加宽修订说明，争取让其表头和解释文字更易读；保留修订后作为最宽文本列，检验较清晰的说明列能否改善整行的阅读。"}]}
